The rabbit asked, "What should I eat?"
"I am very big," said the rabbit.
The rabbit said, "We should try to split the carrot open."
So the rabbit and the rabbit split the carrot open. Inside was a delicious, delicious treat!
The rabbit said, "Thank you, rabbit!"
The rabbit said, "I am so happy to share this apple with everyone!"
So they enjoyed the sweet treat and took good nap. The rabbit was so happy to have made a new friend and they both enjoyed the sweet treat.
